statement: Classical Lissencephalies and Subcortical Band Heterotopias (D054221) — MeSH 2026 scope note: Disorders comprising a spectrum of brain malformations representing the paradigm of a diffuse neuronal migration disorder. statement: Wolf-Hirschhorn Syndrome (D054877) — MeSH 2026 scope note: A syndrome caused by large deletions of the telomereic end of the short arm of CHROMOSOME 4 (4p) in Wolf-Hirchhorn syndrome critial regions (WHSCRs). In addition there is mental retardation, growth delays, EPILEPSY, and frequently a wide range of midline and skeletal defects, including HYPOSPADIAS; CONGENITAL HEART DEFECTS; CLEFT LIP; CLEFT PALATE; colobomata; CLUBFOOT; clinodactyly; SCOLIOSIS; and KYPHOSIS.
